name: Feature request
about: Propose a scoped improvement or adapter
title: "[Feature] "

## Analyst problem

What investigation or handoff problem needs to be solved?

## Proposed behavior

Describe inputs, outputs, and failure behavior.

## Scope fit

Explain how this improves the path from an IOC plus exported evidence to a reviewable package.

## Evidence and security considerations

Address provenance, false positives, sensitive data, network use, and testing with synthetic fixtures.

## Alternatives

Could a specialist tool or integration solve this more appropriately?
